name: Industrial / Modbus
description: Structured Modbus/TCP and reviewed non-EC25 Modbus/RTU holding-register reads.

actions.unavailable_reason: The installed mbtools payload contains read-oriented mbcollect/mbrecorder only. mbpoll is absent, and mbusd is a gateway rather than a reliable register-write client.

help_text: The exact mbcollect runtime supports bounded master-mode holding-register reads through a DDK-generated config for TCP or reviewed non-EC25 RTU. Register write remains unavailable because this target has no mbpoll payload and mbcollect exposes no write operation; mbusd is a gateway, not a register-write client.
